messages:
Nora: Prospect (Atlas Capital) sent an RFI focused on embeddings. Key asks: concrete per-embed pricing with a 3-month commit example, POC isolation options, KMS/HSM proof, and short latency numbers for 512-d at 50 qps. I've uploaded a starter sheet (atlas_rfi_draft.xlsx).
Ethan: Paste the exact POC asks?
Nora: They want: 1) step-down pricing + a 3-month commit sample with monthly caps, 2) single-tenant sandbox + 7-day retention for POC, 3) BYOK + HSM attestation steps, 4) latency SLOs for embed-512 at 50 qps.
Clara: Pricing to sketch into matrix: Hosted tiers then a Dedicated commit example. Sample numbers below.
```
Hosted: $0.00042/embedding (0-500k)
Hosted: $0.00029/embedding (500k-3M)
Dedicated (sample): $0.00017/embedding (9M total over 3 months)
POC credit: $3,000 one-time
```
Ethan: Latency: verified on dedicated A100 pool: p50=22ms p95=58ms at sustained 50 qps with small batching. Hosted p95 ~160-200ms under load.
Tara: KMS/HSM: BYOK supported for Dedicated and Private; HSM-backed keys supported in Private only. We'll provide an attestation doc and vendor compatibility list. doc-bot: [automated] Uploaded atlas_rfi_draft.xlsx and bench_50qps.csv.
Clara: POC ops: 2-week sandbox, isolated tokens, rotate creds weekly, retention can be set to 7 days for POC. We can enable ingest scrub pipeline for PII.
Nora: Add an explicit line for "hard spend caps during POC" 14 they insisted.
Tara: For Hosted we enforce API key hard cutoffs; for Dedicated use contractual caps + runtime throttles. I'll draft a one-paragraph attestation for the RFI.
Ethan: Also add a short FAQ row: "How do you handle PII in embeddings?" Suggest: "Default retention per POC settings; Dedicated/Private allow customer-managed preprocessing or on-prem storage."
Nora: Action items: Clara - finalize pricing table + commit example; Ethan - attach perf CSV and latency note; Tara - HSM attestation paragraph; I'll assemble and send once files are in. Target send: Fri 11:00 PT.
Clara: Uploaded atlas_pricing_v2.xlsx and poc_terms.csv. Link: https://files.redwood/atlas_pricing_v2.xlsx
Tara: Uploaded hsm_attestation_draft.pdf. Pls review.
Nora: Thanks team. I'll do final pass Fri AM and send.
